about: The owner's own Pokémon, known before any battle starts. Recordings of the owner's games take moves, IVs and level from here. ivs are [attack, defence, stamina] as the appraisal shows them; cp is what the Pokémon shows. With both, the exact level, health and damage follow; with ivs missing the usual spread is assumed and health is only approximate. A species may be listed more than once: the one whose cp matches the header is used.
